<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex042012026-10-1309-34-38" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:mtshan_nyid"><milestone n="2. so so'i mtshan nyid" unit="section"/>
				gnyis pa <lb n="41a5"/> so so'i mtshan nyid la gsum ste | mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid dang | mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid dang | mtshan gzhi'i mtshan nyid do || 
<milestone n="21. mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid" unit="section"/>
				dang po mtshon bya rnam par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan thun mong ma yin pa ces pa la 
				<milestone n="a. rngog lo" unit="section"/>
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog lo</rs></note> 'dod la | 
				<milestone n="b. rgya" unit="section"/>
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs></note><note type="editorial">Reading "rgya" unclear.</note> ni mtshon bya mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan ces pa 'ang 'dod cing || 
				<milestone n="c. phya pa" unit="section"/>
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs></note><note type="editorial">Reading "phya pa" unclear.</note> ni bden pa'i don rtogs lta bu mtshan gzhir bzhag nas <lb n="41a6"/> mtshan nyid kyi tha snyad du mtshan pa la | rigs mi mthun gyi spyi'i chos dang dngos 'gal don chos mtshan gzhi la ldan pa ni mtshan nyid yin zhes 'dod te snga ma dang don mthun no || </seg></TEI>
